decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display sits within the firm's core cardboard display competence, and its own R&D lets it interpret results and refine the product.
The pegboard-back shelf display is a close variant of the established offer that the firm can readily assimilate learning into and improve.
The standard quarter-pallet shelf display is a core format directly related to existing knowledge and production capacity.
The eighth-pallet display extends the established cardboard format range, which the firm understands well.
The wooden pallet display is further from the firm's cardboard knowledge base, but it builds on its display expertise and in-house R&D, so it is kept with higher risk.
The media quarter-pallet display applies a core format to a specific segment the firm can serve with its existing knowledge.
